t: You're by Altab Ali Park on Whitechapel Road, the site of St Mary Matfelon, popularly known as St Mary's, Whitechapel. The park rests on the stone footprint of the nave and the old graveyard, whose headstones were removed. The church was firebombed in the Blitz and demolished in 1952. John Brayne, a London grocer, was buried here after dying in 1586. He built the Red Lion playhouse and helped finance the Theatre in Shoreditch with his brother-in-law, James Burbage. Those ventures bankrupted him.
